**Author:** Peter - Cracking Markets (@SystematicPeter) · 2026-08-28 · 123 likes

## Summary
"The results from trading these three simple systems together may surprise you."

- None of the systems is sophisticated: each uses only a **moving average + ATR**, with 1–2 main variables.
- The deliberate design point: each profits from **very different market behavior** (e.g. "Red: slow …" — thread truncated in preview; system definitions and equity curves are on X).

## Why it matters
- Core ensemble lesson: combine systems that harvest *different regimes* (slow trend / fast move / chop) so the portfolio smooths returns instead of stacking correlated risk.
- Simplicity is the feature: fewer parameters → smaller overfitting surface; the diversification does the heavy lifting.
- Follow-up task created: read the full thread for the three system definitions and combined results.
